title: Simulation 3D Ultrasonic Array
text: Ultrasonic sensor model with tunable acoustic parameters in 3D simulation environment, 6 outputs, {Mounting location} sets Sensor mounting location; {Sensor identifier} sets the unique, {Parent name} sets the name, {Specify offset}, {Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)} sets the translation, {Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)} sets the rotational, {Sample time}, {Relative mounting locations (m)} sets the relative mounting locations of individual sensors in the ultrasonic [0, -0.22, 0]; {Relative mounting rotations (deg)} sets the relative mounting rotations of individual sensors in the ultrasonic, {Horizontal Field of view (deg)} sets the horizontal field of view of ultrasonic, {Vertical field of view (deg)} sets the vertical field of view of ultrasonic array, {Detection ranges (m)} sets the detection range vector of ultrasonic array, {Acoustic frequency (kHz)} sets the frequency of sound waves used by all sensor emitters in ultrasonic, {Sampling frequency (kHz)} sets the sampling frequency of all sensor receivers in ultrasonic, {Pulse width (s)} sets the pulse width of ultrasonic waves used by all sensors in ultrasonic array, {Gain} sets the vector gain for sound signal used by sensors in ultrasonic array, {Sound speed (m/s)} sets the speed of sound in environment, {Use bus output} selects to output signals together as bus and {Output location (m) and orientation (rad)} sets the output location and orientation of sensor. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Detections
ports.summary: Object detections Simulink bus containing MATLAB ® structure

ports.name: Has object
ports.summary: Flag indicating whether any detectable object is present in the sensor field-of-view true | false

ports.name: Has range
ports.summary: Flag indicating whether range measurement is possible for any object present in the sensor field-of-view true | false

ports.name: Range
ports.summary: Distance measurement to the closest object nonnegative scalar

params.name: Parent name
params.values: Name of parent vehicle Scene Origin (default) | vehicle name

params.name: Mounting location
params.values: Sensor mounting location Origin (default) | Front bumper | Rear bumper | Right mirror | Left mirror | Rearview mirror | Hood center | Roof center |...

params.name: Specify offset
params.values: Specify offset from mounting location off (default) | on

params.name: Relative translation [X, Y, Z] (m)
params.values: Translation offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative rotation [Roll, Pitch, Yaw] (deg)
params.values: Rotational offset relative to mounting location [0, 0, 0] (default) | real-valued 1-by-3 vector

params.name: Relative mounting locations (m)
params.values: Relative mounting locations of individual sensors in the ultrasonic array [[0, -0.67, 0]; [0, -0.22, 0]; [0, 0.22, 0]; [0, 0.67, 0]] (default) | real-valued N -by- 3 array

params.name: Relative mounting rotations (deg)
params.values: Relative mounting rotations of individual sensors in the ultrasonic array zeros(4,3) (default) | real-valued N -by- 3 array

params.name: Horizontal Field of view (deg)
params.values: Horizontal field of view of ultrasonic array 70 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Vertical field of view (deg)
params.values: Vertical field of view of ultrasonic array 35 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Detection ranges (m)
params.values: Detection range vector of ultrasonic array (m) [0.03 0.15 5.5] (default) | 1-by-3 nonnegative real-valued vector of form [minDetOnlyRange minDistRange maxDistRange]

params.name: Acoustic frequency (kHz)
params.values: Frequency of sound waves used by all sensor emitters in ultrasonic array 50 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Sampling frequency (kHz)
params.values: Sampling frequency of all sensor receivers in ultrasonic array 500 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Pulse width (s)
params.values: Pulse width of ultrasonic waves used by all sensors in ultrasonic array 1e-6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Gain
params.values: Vector gain for sound signal used by sensors in ultrasonic array [1, 0] (default) | real-valued scalar | real-valued 1 -by- 2 vector

params.name: Sound speed (m/s)
params.values: Speed of sound in environment 330 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Use bus output
params.values: Select to output signals together as bus signal on (default) | off

params.name: Output location (m) and orientation (rad)
params.values: Output location and orientation of sensor off (default) | on
